# Scanpath Studio

> Free, open-source software for visualizing eye-tracking data from reading studies: scanpaths, fixations, saccades, gaze heatmaps and raw gaze drawn over the text, from EyeLink, Tobii and other eye trackers.

Scanpath Studio is an interactive Streamlit workbench, a Python API (`import scanpath_studio as sps`) and a CLI (`scanpath-studio`) for eye-tracking-while-reading data: it draws fixations, saccades and heatmaps over the text at its true on-screen position, shows the per-word reading measures your data brings (FFD, FPRT, RPD, TFD, skips, regressions), compares participants, and exports figures and tables. The bundled demo is a subset of the OneStop Eye Movements corpus.
